articles.summary: Jumia Technologies AG secured $50 million in fresh equity funding from its biggest shareholder and the World Bank’s International Finance Corp. as the African e-commerce company pushes toward its first profit.
articles.title: Jumia Wins IFC, Axian Backing in $50 Million Equity Fundraising (Bloomberg)
Jumia de-risks profitability path with $50M IFC deal, CEO says (Investing.com)

articles.summary: Washington, D.C., August 12, 2026 — The World Bank Group is supporting the expansion of Africa's digital commerce infrastructure to help small businesses reach new markets, create jobs, and strengthen economic opportunities across the continent. Through Jumia (NYSE: JMIA), Africa's leading e-commerce platform, the investment is expected to enable approximately 60,000 local annual active sellers to participate more fully in the digital economy, support around 1,800 direct jobs, and create income-generating opportunities for more than 100,000 independent sales agents.
articles.title: World Bank Group Invests in Africa's Digital Commerce Infrastructure to Support Jobs and Small Businesses (IFC)
